CustomField.description: The shadow person this row is about, where the subject type is Shadow_Person. WIRED AT ADDENDUM 19 so the type is no longer a picklist value with nothing behind it. Read the narrowing with it: addendum 18 put the live person key on AAO_Participant__c, which covers the same people and covers them earlier, because participation is written at ingest before any projection decision has been made. So this lookup exists, composes a key, and is not what the pass writes; the shadow row's real job is projection-side, carrying a person into the customer's org where a Contact cannot be made.
CustomField.label: Shadow Person
